snippet.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of The Tide - Unreal Engine 5.6 Performance Improvements Benchmark
snippet.description:
We examine the demo for SpongeBob SquarePants TotT demo, one of the first Unreal Engine 5.6 games which claims to bring CPU multithreading optimizations and better frametimes overall. 
Is this the case? Let's find out in this video as I test both high end and budget CPU's.

PC #1
RTX 4090 (GPU)
Ryzen 9800X3D (CPU)
32GB DDR5 6000Mhz C30 (RAM)
Strix X670E-A Gaming WiFi (MOBO)
12TB Gen 4 NVME SSD (Storage)
EVGA 1000GT (PSU)
Windows 11PRO

PC #2
PC Build:
Ryzen 5500 (CPU)
RX 9070XT 16GB (GPU)
32GB DDR4 3200mhz CL16 (RAM)
Strix B550F Gaming WiFi (MOBO)
Gen4 NVME SSD (Storage)

00:00 Introduction
01:28 TSR vs TAA High Cost
02:41 High End CPU
04:19 Lumen or No Lumen?
05:27 Budget CPU
07:14 Conclusion
